fixture_adjustments.resolution: Actual connectionError invokes x(false), which schedules native f10 teardown. The probe now checks actual x(true) rejection: no hm0 job, p null, unchanged q, switch off. No production change.

fixture_adjustments.resolution: Read the expected localized message from the actual APK qv4.b resource function.

fixture_adjustments.resolution: Wait for actual expected flag pixels before saving each final screenshot.

fixture_adjustments.resolution: Use the actual screenshot header icon region and PH/NL red/blue vertical ordering. Final five screenshots contain the expected loaded flags.

limits: Actual native entry and coroutine creation are verified, but the captured connection body is never run. No hardware SIM, APDU authentication, DNS/ePDG/IKE/IMS network, carrier registration, live call or audio was tested.
The rendered UI is the shipped native fd2.r reader card in an independent MainActivity Compose host with synthetic card state, not a hand-built substitute or full reader navigation.
The readiness label means the local enable path is available; these tests do not establish that a carrier accepts the synthetic/current identity.
Only isolated temporary preferences and test runtime state were changed; the final signed production APK remained byte-identical across all runs.
